rust_summary: a cancellable nether portal about to form in a lit frame (`native_portal_spawn`).
doc_summary: `native_portal_spawn(dimension, pos, state, shape, cancel)`, in `BaseFireBlock.onPlace` once a fire placed at `pos` (`state`) found an empty obsidian frame (`shape`, a `NativePortalShape`: axis, bottom-left block, width, height), in the Overworld or the Nether. Set `cancel` and no portal forms: the fire stays where it can survive, as without a frame. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:portal_spawn@.
